metadata.title: जंगल में ओपन एयर थियेटर । An open air theatre in the Jungle
metadata.description:
Salbani is a small village in Baleshwar district of Odisha. And in the jungles in Salbani, there is something unique happening. The Tribals here have come together to start a open air theatre inside the forest. 
This place also serves as an art school for the adivasi population here. The elders of the village and a few renowned artists from the state are teaching the new generation about Adivasi culture.

#Odisha #Birsa_Munda #Tribal_Art
